attempts.prompt: Create a clean anime character design reference sheet for a Pokemon fan game. Show Ash Ketchum at three life stages side by side: his familiar young Kanto self in the classic red and white cap, blue vest, white short sleeves, jeans and green gloves; an older teenage traveler with the same recognizable face, cap and blue clothing; and a young adult traveler with a slightly longer blue jacket and the same visual identity. Natural age-appropriate proportions, fully clothed practical adventure outfits, friendly to thoughtful expressions, head-to-toe front three-quarter views, shoes fully visible. Each stage has a small back view beside it. White background, consistent crisp cel shading, useful clothing details for a future game artist. No extra characters, no text, no logo or watermark. This is a single age-progression concept sheet, not a sprite sheet.
